channel.title: Acquia incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Acquia's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Intermittent Pipeline Job Start Failures [monitoring]
item.description: We are no longer seeing new instances of the issue affecting pipeline job starts. Our team continues to monitor the service for any recurrence. Further updates will be provided as more information becomes available.

item.title: Error rates for Acquia Task System [resolved]
item.description: The service interruption impacting the Acquia Task system has been fully resolved. AWS US-WEST-2 operations have stabilized, and all queued tasks and system functions are operating normally.

item.title: Multiple customers are currently affected by what appears to be an outage impacting the Site Studio endpoint [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting Site Studio endpoints has been fully resolved, and all systems are operational now.

item.title: Degraded Performance - SearchStax Pulse Performance Graphs [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Our upstream search infrastructure partner, SearchStax, has successfully implemented the fix, and Pulse Performance Graphs are now displaying as expected. Core search functionality was unaffected throughout this incident. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience.

item.title: Acquia DAM Service Outage [resolved]
item.description: We've resolve the problem causing an issue with some customers ability to log into DAM. Contact Customer Support for help on Acquia DAM Community if you continue to experience any ongoing issues.

item.title: Pipelines is down for MEO customers [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting access to the Pipelines UI and Dashboard for MEO customers has been fully resolved. A fix was deployed and verification was completed to confirm that the Pipelines Dashboard is fully operational and performing normally.

item.title: Acquia DAM Degraded File Processing [resolved]
item.description: We've resolved the issue causing degraded file processing for customers hosted in the EU and have completed processing work that accumulated during the incident. Contact Customer Support for help on Acquia DAM Community if you continue to experience any ongoing issues.

item.title: Vendor API Issue: Security and Performance Metrics [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting Edge Standard customers has been resolved. Akamai has addressed the vendor API issue, and security and performance metrics are now available in the Edge Standard UI

item.title: Incident with Akamai [resolved]
item.description: We can confirm that the issue was confirmed mitigated at 20:42 UTC on August 18, 2026 and the service has resumed normal operation.

item.title: Log Download Failures [resolved]
item.description: The log download issue affecting Acquia Cloud Next and MEO customers was resolved on Aug 11 09:38 UTC, and all systems are fully operational.

item.title: New Support Ticket Creation Impacted in Cloud UI Portal [resolved]
item.description: The underlying cause of this service interruption has been addressed. All services are operational at this time.

item.title: Delays in Database Backups and Code Deployments on Acquia Cloud Platform [resolved]
item.description: The underlying cause of this service interruption has been addressed. All services are operational at this time.

item.title: Acquia Cloud Pipelines – Jobs Failing to Start (Queued State) [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting Acquia Cloud Pipelines has been resolved. Pipeline processing has returned to normal operations, and all previously queued jobs have been handled. Please note that if any of your queued jobs failed with a "system failure" message during the incident, they can now be safely re-run. We appreciate your patience while we worked to restore service.

item.title: Issue Affecting Related & Popular Search Results [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting related and popular search functionality and Pulse monitoring has been fully resolved. All systems are operational. We appreciate your patience during this incident.

item.title: SearchStax: Issue Affecting Related & Popular Search Results [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: AcquiaDAM sites not available [resolved]
item.description: We've resolved the issue affecting the availability of some sites. Contact Customer Support for help on Acquia DAM Community if you continue to experience any ongoing issues.

item.title: GitHub Incident Impacting Acquia Pipelines [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting Acquia Pipelines is now completely resolved. Git connectivity and pipeline processing have returned to normal operations, and we do not anticipate any further impact.

item.title: Temporary Disruption In CDN Provisioning For Acquia Edge Standard [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting CDN provisioning for Edge Standard has been fully resolved. New domain configurations are now processing successfully, and we have confirmed stability across the environment. No further impact is expected. We apologise for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience while we worked through this.

item.title: Acquia has detected a temporary service interruption affecting Acquia Edge powered by Cloudflare services [resolved]
item.description: The underlying cause of this interruption has been addressed. All affected services have been restored. All services are operational at this time.

item.title: CDP Google ads campaign failure in production [resolved]
item.description: The underlying cause of this interruption has been addressed. All affected services have been restored. All services are operational at this time.

item.title: Investigating Login Issues with Acquia Campaign Studio and Campaign Factory, [resolved]
item.description: The login issues affecting Acquia Campaign Studio and Campaign Factory have been completely resolved, and all systems are fully operational.

item.title: Acquia has detected a service interruption affecting multiple servers and balancers in us-east-1b [resolved]
item.description: The issue with our upstream provider has been fully resolved, and all affected services have been restored to normal operations. Thank you for your patience while we worked to address this issue.

item.title: Degraded Portals Performance [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue causing degraded Portals performance for some customers. Contact Customer Support for help on Acquia DAM Community if you continue to experience any ongoing issues.

item.title: Shared bals were down impacting multiple customers [resolved]
item.description: We've detected a service interruption affecting the stability for your application. The issue was quickly identified and resolved. Everything is up and running now.

item.title: Issue impacting shared REC load balancers impacting multiple customers [resolved]
item.description: We've detected a service interruption affecting the shared load balancers for certain customer applications. All services are operational at this time.

item.title: Acquia DAM Degraded Performance [resolved]
item.description: The underlying cause of this issue has been addressed. All affected services have been restored. All services are operational at this time.

item.title: Issue Impacting Code Deployments on Cloud Platform [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting code deployments for a subset of customers on our Cloud Platform has now been resolved. Our engineering team has implemented a fix and all code deployment functionalities are now restored.

item.title: Issue Impacting Code Deployments on Cloud Platform [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting code deployments for a subset of customers on our Cloud Platform has now been resolved. Our engineering team has implemented a fix and all code deployment functionalities are now restored.

item.title: Acquia has detected TFA Authentication Issues Resulting in 403 Forbidden Errors [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting Two-Factor Authentication (TFA) and preventing logins to the Acquia Cloud UI has been fully resolved, and all systems are now fully operational. If you continue to experience any lingering issues, please reach out by filing a support ticket. Thank you for your patience during this interruption.

item.title: Issue Impacting Code Deployments on Cloud Platform [resolved]
item.description: Acquia has resolved the issue impacting code deployments for a subset of customers on our Cloud Platform. Users should no longer experience rejected git push commands, as full deployment functionality has been completely restored. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while we worked to fix this.
